title: Whole-home audio

roles.label: Sonos Amp

quantity.verify: one Sonos Amp per audio zone

roles.capability: Streams and powers one audio zone, controlled from the Sonos app

roles.label: Sonos In-Ceiling speakers (pair)

quantity.verify: one pair of in-ceiling speakers per indoor zone

roles.capability: In-ceiling architectural speakers by Sonance, one pair per room

roles.label: Sonos Outdoor speakers (pair)

quantity.verify: outdoor areas to cover, one pair each

roles.capability: Weather-resistant architectural speakers by Sonance for outdoor living areas

roles.label: Sonos Port
roles.capability: Adds Sonos streaming to an existing stereo or receiver

labor.basis: Livewire packages since 2025: Sonos Amp Package 0.5 hours, SONOS by Sonance In-Ceiling Speakers package 2.9 hours per pair (retrofit with wire); so each amp and Port carries 0.5 hours and each speaker pair 3 hours, plus 1 hour of setup: 8 hours for a typical two-zone job; a Sonos Amp about 1 hour (backtest of 9 accepted amp-only jobs, median 1.2 h)

assumptions: Speakers are retrofit into accessible ceilings with new speaker wire to the equipment location.
A working Wi-Fi network covers the equipment location; Sonos is controlled from the Sonos app.
Quantities marked as minimums are confirmed during a site visit.
exclusions: Televisions, soundbars and home theater (quoted separately).
